method: Hash-ordered sample (sha1 of slug) from the first 1100 corpus clips in 22 shards, 16 with >=2 identity jumps and 16 with 0. A jump is a centre move >1 median body diagonal across at most 2 frames. Six evenly spaced overlay frames per clip, coded by one AI agent, not blinded to the group, not owner-checked.
codes: wrong = skeleton on someone other than the performer in at least one sampled frame while the performer is plausibly in view; unclear = could not tell, or only an end frame with the performer gone; ok = no wrong frame seen
